title: Back End Developer
description:
At SOTEC Consulting-Astek Group are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain robust backend services and real-time data pipelines using Apache Kafka , Spring Boot microservices , and Apache Flink . The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and stream processing, with a passion for building scalable and high-performance backend solutions.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Spring Boot microservices , with a strong emphasis on event-driven architectures powered by Apache Kafka .
  • Implement and optimize Kafka producers, consumers, and stream processing applications, leveraging Apache Flink for real-time data streaming and analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, DevOps, and fellow developers to ensure seamless integration of Kafka, Flink, and microservices across the backend ecosystem.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Kafka clusters and Flink jobs to guarantee performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Ensure data security, compliance, and adherence to best practices in all Kafka and Flink-related implementations.
  • Participate in code reviews, design sessions, and agile ceremonies , contributing to continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Document architectures, technical solutions, and maintain comprehensive and up-to-date system documentation.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering , or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in backend development, with a strong focus on Apache Kafka and Spring Boot microservices .
  • Proven hands-on experience with Apache Flink for real-time data processing and streaming .
  • Proficiency in Java or Scala for backend and stream-processing applications.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems , event-driven architectures , and microservices design patterns .
  • Experience with RESTful APIs , message brokers , and data serialization formats (e.g., Avro, JSON).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
  • Good communication skills in Portguese (B2 minimum) and English (B1)


Nice to Have


  • Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS ).
  • Knowledge of additional streaming frameworks or technologies .
  • Prior experience in financial services or regulated environments .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools , such as the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).


This is a hybrid position and the candidate selected will need to be present in the office some days.

title: Chief Risk Officer
description:
About Patria


Patria is a leading alternative investment firm in Latin America, recognised for its long‑term vision, strong performance culture, and commitment to developing high‑impact, sustainable businesses. We pride ourselves on attracting exceptional talent and fostering a collaborative environment where ideas thrive and people grow to their full potential.


About the Role


The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) will be responsible for further developing and implementing Patria’s global risk management framework across all asset classes and strategies, including private equity, private credit and infrastructure. This leader will build and manage a team of risk subject-matter experts (enterprise, financial/investment and non‑financial risk & controls) and act as a trusted advisor to senior management and investment teams globally.


Key Responsibilities


Risk Framework & Governance


  • Design, implement and oversee Patria’s risk management framework, incorporating SOX and leading Operational Risk Management methodologies (e.g. COSO).
  • Establish and maintain policies, standards and governance structures to promote a consistent risk culture across the firm.
  • Represent the Risk Management function in senior corporate governance committees and forums.


Risk Identification, Assessment & Monitoring


  • Identify, assess and monitor key risks across the firm, including investment, market, credit and non‑financial risks (e.g. operational, conduct, model, technology and third‑party risks).
  • Ensure that risk exposures are well understood, aligned with client objectives and Patria’s risk appetite, and appropriately managed.
  • Develop and maintain risk dashboards, KRIs and regular reporting for senior leadership and the Board.


Partnership with the Business


  • Work closely with investment teams to embed robust risk considerations into investment decision‑making and portfolio management.
  • Provide constructive challenge and commercially oriented risk insights to support sustainable business growth.
  • Act as a key point of contact on risk topics for senior management and other stakeholders.


Risk Methodologies, Tools & Analytics


  • Lead quantitative and qualitative analyses, including stress tests and scenario analyses, to evaluate how portfolios might perform under market and macroeconomic stress.
  • Enhance methodologies, models and tools used to measure, aggregate and manage risk across products, strategies and geographies.


Controls, Compliance & Regulation


  • Partner with Compliance, Internal Controls and other second‑line functions to align and strengthen the overall control environment.
  • Stay current with evolving regulatory requirements and industry best practices, ensuring adherence to all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies.


Team Leadership


  • Build, lead and develop a high‑performing team of risk professionals across enterprise, financial/investment and non‑financial risk.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement, with strong connectivity to business and functional partners.


Requirements


Experience


  • 10–15 years of proven Risk Management experience in Financial Services, ideally with significant exposure to alternative asset management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior Risk Management leadership role (e.g. Head of Risk, Deputy CRO or equivalent) with direct interaction with executive management and governance bodies.


Technical & Strategic Skills


  • Deep understanding of risk management frameworks and internal control environments (including SOX, COSO and Operational Risk Management).
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate rigorous risk management and control frameworks with sharp commercial insight, enabling responsible and scalable business growth.
  • Experience covering investment, market, credit and non‑financial risks in multi‑asset, multi‑jurisdictional contexts.


Leadership & Interpersonal Skills


  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusted, constructive relationships with investment teams, senior management and control functions.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience building, developing and retaining diverse, high‑performing teams.


Education & Languages


  • Degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics or another quantitative / business‑related field.
  • Advanced degree and/or relevant professional certifications (e.g. MBA, CFA, FRM, PRM) strongly preferred.
  • Fluency in English required; knowledge of Portuguese and/or Spanish is a strong plus.


What We Offer


Opportunity to work in a leading global asset manager with a high-performance, entrepreneurial culture.

Exposure to senior leadership and strategic talent initiatives across multiple geographies.

A flexible, inclusive, and supportive work environment.

Competitive compensation and benefits.

Work Environment


At Patria, we believe that how we achieve our goals is as important as the results themselves. Our way of working is a key differentiator, helping us retain the best team, build long-term relationships, and generate superior returns. We are:


  1. Ethical and aligned to our clients’ objectives
  2. Associative, complementary, and united by a purpose
  3. Disciplined, criteria-driven, and hands-on
  4. Committed to fostering a high-performance environment
  5. Diversity & Inclusion


Patria is committed to equal opportunity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. All employment decisions are based on individual merit and organizational needs.

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Product Designer Sênior - São Paulo/SP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Hibrido. 1 a 2 vezes por semana em Perdizes/São Paulo.
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Product Designer responsável por projetar produtos com experiências intuitivas e envolventes, focando na solução de problemas de negócio por meio de princípios de design centrado no usuário. O objetivo é desenvolver soluções efetivas que ofereçam experiências únicas e personalizadas para nossos clientes, atendendo às necessidades específicas de cada segmento, desde a pesquisa inicial até a entrega de soluções visualmente atraentes e altamente funcionais.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Você será uma peça-chave em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto, com as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Diagnóstico: Identificar problemas e oportunidades analisando as dores dos usuários e as metas do negócio.
  • Pesquisa: Conduzir entrevistas, mapear jornadas e interpretar dados analíticos para guiar decisões.
  • Criação: Idear soluções criativas e muito significativas para as pessoas usuárias, trazendo experiências fluidas, lindas e, por que não, surpreendentes.
  • Prototipação e Design: Desenvolver fluxos, wireframes e interfaces impecáveis com componentes detalhados e organizados no Figma, garantindo adesão ao Design System e práticas de acessibilidade.
  • Validação: Realizar testes de usabilidade, aplicar testes A/B, validar a viabilidade técnica das soluções junto às equipes de engenharia e acompanhar métricas pós-lançamento para ajustar e aprimorar as entregas.
  • Colaboração: Atuar em uma equipe multidisciplinar, interna e externa, participando de rituais e tomadas de decisão, liderando projetos que promovam a interação entre designers e outros times, além de colaborar diretamente com equipes de engenharia para garantir a implementação eficaz das soluções.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Foco no usuário: Antecipar e atender às necessidades dos usuários dentro de um time de produto, garantindo soluções que agreguem valor e proporcionem boas experiências.
  • Comunicação e negociação: Colaborar com equipes de negócios e engenharia, traduzindo problemas complexos em soluções práticas e funcionais.
  • Tomada de decisão: Ter embasamento e agir com segurança e assertividade ao tomar decisões importantes.
  • Paixão pelo design: Interesse genuíno em participar de todas as etapas do processo de design, desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Formação e ferramentas: Formação em Design, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas, com experiência sólida no uso de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe Illustrator e Photoshop.
  • Design System e acessibilidade: Domínio guias de estilo e práticas de acessibilidade, incluindo cores, contrastes e padrões de usabilidade.
  • Pesquisa e análise: Habilidade em conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas de avaliação do produto, sempre transformando dados em insights estratégicos.
  • Apresentação de ideias: Capacidade de articular propostas e apresentar soluções baseadas em dados e insights do usuário.
  • Habilidade de antecipar problemas e adaptação a cenários imprevisíveis: A candidata/o deve ser proativa/o na identificação de desafios antecipados e capaz de se adaptar rapidamente a mudanças inesperadas, ajustando soluções para garantir a eficácia e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência prática no uso de Inteligência Artificial em seus processos criativos.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;

title: Especialista Suprimentos - Matéria Prima
description:
Sobre a vaga


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.


Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.


Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência


Sobre o papel

Realizar a gestão estratégica e operacional do suprimento de matéria-prima principal (produtos químicos primários, embalagem etc.), desde a identificação das necessidades de compra, desenvolvimento e gestão de fornecedores, negociação de contratos, acompanhamento da logística e da qualidade da matéria-prima, até a otimização de custos e a garantia do abastecimento contínuo e eficiente para a produção.



Atividades principais :

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de suprimentos de matéria-prima alinhadas com a produção e financeiros da empresa, considerando demanda, preços de mercado, disponibilidade e riscos;
  • Identificar, qualificar, desenvolver e gerenciar um portfólio de fornecedores de matéria-prima;
  • Liderar o processo de negociação de contratos de fornecimento de matéria-prima;
  • Monitorar e analisar o mercado de matéria-prima (preços, tendências, regulamentações, riscos) ;
  • Estabelecer e monitorar os padrões de qualidade da matéria-prima recebida;
  • Planejar e coordenar a logística de transporte da matéria-prima, otimizando rotas, custos e prazos de entrega, garantindo o fluxo contínuo para a fábrica;
  • Gestão de Custos: Buscar continuamente a otimização dos custos de aquisição da matéria-prima;
  • Gestão de Riscos: Identificar, avaliar e mitigar os riscos associados ao suprimento de matéria-prima;
  • Gestão de Contratos e Pedidos: Administrar os contratos de fornecimento e os pedidos de compra;
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho dos fornecedores de matéria-prima, utilizando indicadores-chave (KPIs);
  • Colaborar estreitamente com as áreas de produção, planejamento, qualidade, financeiro e jurídico;
  • Garantir que os processos de suprimentos estejam conforme as políticas internas, as regulamentações ambientais e de sustentabilidade aplicáveis ao setor de celulose;
  • Buscar e avaliar continuamente novas fontes de suprimento de matéria-prima;
  • Criar e analisar indicadores que facilitem a administração das demandas de matéria-prima, tais como níveis de estoque, fluxo contínuo de abastecimento, Saving, Lead Time, acompanhamento da demanda, Prazo de Entregas, Devoluções;
  • Desenvolver, propor e buscar aprovação de estratégias de otimização dos custos das compras;
  • Apoiar a gerência na administração dos custos, atuando na previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend);
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias, participar e apoiar projetos, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados a área de Suprimentos;
  • Elaborar e propor de planos de contingência para as compras de matéria-prima.


Qualificações :

  • Necessário formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Power Point avançado;
  • SAP;
  • Power BI;
  • Criação e interpretação de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Matemática financeira com foco em formação de custos, dinâmicas de fluxo de caixa e viabilidade de investimentos.


Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Desejável especialização em: Gestão da cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão Financeira, Logística, Gestão de Projetos;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Strategic Sourcing (canais de fornecimento com otimização de custos);

  • BATNA (técnica de negociação).

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

  • Criar materiais para acompanhamento do fornecedor e reuniões de JBP, com informações de mercado IQVIA/Close up x Empresa, ciclo de caixa, nível de serviço, lead time, dias de estoque, excesso, utilizando-os também nas reuniões de revisões de negócios.

Gestão Da Cadeia De Suprimentos

Gestão Financeira

  • Excel Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Experiência prévia no mercado farmacêutico e/ou bens de consumo;
  • Facilidade em análises contratuais.
  • Eperiência em gestão de compras, preferencialmente no segmento farma;
  • Capacidade de negociar e fechar acordos vantajosos para a empresa, com foco em custos, prazos e qualidade;
  • Habilidade para construir e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores, áreas internas e stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de analisar dados e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Capacidade de liderar e motivar equipes, delegando tarefas e responsabilidades.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações de forma clara e concisa;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado do mercado farma e das principais tendências do setor e categoria;

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em negociação com grandes fornecedores da indústria farmacêutica;

description:

Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together. Learn more at


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate Tier 1/2 carriers & ISPs
  • Sell GTT’s international network services, including Global WAN, Ethernet, Direct Internet Access, IP Transit, SD-WAN, and MPLS.

  • Candidates must speak, English, Spanish and Portuguese.



Required Experience/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the LATAM wholesale carrier market, including the commercial landscape, pricing dynamics, and cross-border connectivity trends. Knowledge of major Tier 1 carriers and regional operators—such as Claro, Telefónica, América Móvil, and Millicom—is essential to identify opportunities and negotiate effectively. This expertise will enable the candidate to position GTT’s global network solutions competitively and drive strategic growth in the region.

  • 5–10+ years of experience in wholesale or reseller sales within the telecom or networking industry.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing deals with Tier 1 carriers, ISPs, and channel partners.
  • Strong knowledge of global WAN services, Ethernet, DIA, IP Transit, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN, Miller Heiman, or similar.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical topics and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Experience selling SD-WAN and security solutions.
  • Established network of contacts within the carrier and reseller ecosystem.


Core Competencies:

  • Negotiating
  • Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Networking
  • Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive.
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations
  • Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling
  • Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer need.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing)
  • Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level. Builds relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job 

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.


Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.

title: Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil
description:
A função

A Kaleido está em busca de um Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil para nos representar como a face técnica do nosso negócio no país. Nesta posição sênior, você será responsável por conduzir ciclos complexos de pré-vendas, fortalecer o ecossistema de parceiros, impulsionar uma comunidade técnica vibrante e supervisionar as primeiras implementações de clientes. Você garantirá que os PoCs e as entregas iniciais em Kaleido/FireFly estabeleçam o padrão em segurança, conformidade e escala.


Sobre nós

A Kaleido oferece uma plataforma de próxima geração para construção e conexão com redes descentralizadas (ex.: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Canton) em nuvem e Kubernetes. Combinamos tecnologias open source e proprietárias para fornecer middleware, gestão de ativos digitais e soluções de custódia. Nossa plataforma permite que clientes criem casos de uso corporativos integrados a ecossistemas descentralizados e ativos digitais — seja em nosso SaaS ou em nuvens privadas.


Responsabilidades

Arquitetura de Soluções em Pré-Vendas

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery, delimitar escopos de soluções, realizar demonstrações, desenvolver PoCs e analisar RFPs; produzir propostas técnicas, estimativas e arquiteturas prontas para SOW.
  • Mapear requisitos regulatórios e de conformidade no Brasil (ex.: CVM 175, LGPD, controles do setor financeiro) para desenhos técnicos, boas práticas de segurança e runbooks.
  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso; acelerar a transição de PoC para produção.

Ecossistema de Parceiros e Alianças

  • Identificar, recrutar, integrar e capacitar parceiros.
  • Desenvolver programas de capacitação: currículo, laboratórios práticos, trilhas de certificação, ativos reutilizáveis (implementações de referência, blueprints Terraform/K8s, templates de contratos).
  • Conduzir iniciativas de co-sell e co-delivery com estratégias de GTM conjuntas e governança clara.

Comunidade Técnica e Evangelismo

  • Representar a Kaleido em meetups, conferências e universidades; liderar workshops, bootcamps e hackathons.
  • Publicar conteúdo técnico (blogs, tutoriais, apps de exemplo, arquiteturas de referência) e manter repositórios OSS demonstrando boas práticas de FireFly/EVM.
  • Formar uma rede de contribuidores e cultivar champions e maintainers locais.

Arquitetura e Acompanhamento das Primeiras Entregas

  • Orientar implementações referência em Kaleido/FireFly (EVM/Besu/Quorum), padrões de privacidade, troca de dados e integrações com sistemas bancários (APIs, eventos, ISO 20022).
  • Definir SLOs/SLIs, IaC (Terraform/Kubernetes), CI/CD, observabilidade e assegurar a transição suave para os times de entrega e sucesso do cliente.

Segurança e Padrões de Custódia

  • Projetar integrações seguras de gestão de chaves e custódia (HSM/KMS, MPC, cofres).
  • Aplicar modelagem de ameaças, auditoria e controles de privacidade em casos de uso regulados.

Feedback de Produto

  • Canalizar insights de mercado e parceiros para o roadmap global, defendendo padrões específicos do Brasil.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação/Engenharia (ou experiência equivalente).
  • 6+ anos em engenharia de software; 3+ anos em pré-vendas/soluções com clientes; 3+ anos em blockchain corporativo.
  • Experiência prática com EVM (Solidity, upgradeability, Hardhat/Foundry) e Kaleido/FireFly (ou frameworks similares de private-tx/data-exchange).
  • Conhecimento em padrões de integração com REST/gRPC, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, mensageria e ISO 20022; familiaridade com fluxos de liquidação (PIX/SPI/STR, DvP).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders (executivos, vendas, produto, reguladores).
  • Fluência em português e inglês avançado; espanhol é um diferencial.


Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência no desenho de programas de capacitação de parceiros (trilhas de certificação, conteúdos, soluções conjuntas).
  • Conhecimento em Hyperledger Fabric e/ou R3 Corda.
  • Certificações de segurança ou nuvem (CISSP/CCSK, AWS/Azure, CKA/CKAD).
  • Experiência em palestras, publicação de conteúdo técnico ou contribuições ativas em OSS.


Diversidade e Inclusão

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

title: Profissional Analista SRE
description:
Ei, quer trabalhar em uma empresa com plano de carreira que coloca você como protagonista?


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Profissional com sólida experiência em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, forte atuação em ambientes cloud AWS e domínio de práticas DevOps.

Vivência com Kubernetes, Docker e ferramentas de observabilidade/monitoramento em tempo real.

Também é importante que tenha habilidade em criação e manutenção de scripts de automação (Python, Bash ou PowerShell).

Diferenciais desejáveis:

– Conhecimento em redes (protocolos, configuração e segurança).

– Atuação com gestão de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:


- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


  • E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Previdência Privada; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Sales Manager
description:
China Telecom do Brasil, is seeking a strategic sales professional, with Chinese culture and language expertise, who enjoys developing new prospects and interacting with existing customers. Sales Managers work prospecting and qualifying clients, ultimately building a sustainable pipeline to increase sales of China Telecom Brasils' products and services. Successful Sales Managers are familiar with a variety of marketing concepts, practices and procedures. This position relies on broad experience (sales and telecom) and judgment to plan and accomplish sales goals.


Major Tasks & Responsibilities:

Reporting directly to the Sales Director, Chinese Enterprise Sales, the Sales Manager will be responsible to develop business for Chinese customers of China Telecom Brasil focused on ISPs, carriers and enterprise business in the Brazilian markets.

Focusing on internet service providers, carriers and enterprise market, Sales Managers will be expected to meet, and encouraged to exceed aggressive revenue targets while accomplishing the following:


  • Responsible for selling IP, transport circuit (IEPL), MPLS VPN, SDWAN, Datacenter products (IDC), and CPE projects (ICT) and other data products in the Brazilian market, meeting quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Develop long-term relationships with our enterprise, ISP and carrier customers
  • Identify sales leads, provide sale support (including working with engineering and operations for the successful cutover of sold services), manage sales processes, close sales deals, and negotiate terms and conditions
  • Manage against branch budget goals relating to direct and indirect expenses
  • Review and organize business case documentation for Bid Reviews and/or other requests requiring approval from senior management
  • Take overall leadership position on contract negotiations and coordinate Executive, Legal and Operational resources to drive process to timely completion
  • Develop and document formal territory plan that clearly analyzes and defines the target customers, and articulates the strategies and tactics to develop business with them
  • Manage and document adequate sales pipeline (estimated 5X annual revenue target)
  • Provide accurate weekly activity, and various monthly and ad hoc reports to senior management
  • Act as an escalation point for customers to remove any and all obstacles to developing business in the target markets



Essential Skills, Qualification and Education Needed:

  • Sales experience selling to multinational corporations
  • Experience selling both business and technical solutions preferred
  • Experience in selling global network solutions between Brasil and Asia Pacific regions a plus
  • Proven selling techniques and strong account management skills; able to conduct prospecting and manage customers independently
  • Good understanding of global telecom, IT solutions, and sound knowledge of the market trend
  • Solid individual network with telecom industry and corporate community
  • Fluency in both Mandarin and Portuguese preferred. Mandarin required.
  • Flexibility to work seamlessly with global sales team in different time zones
  • Self-motivated, customer-focused, result-oriented
  • Excellent interpersonal and communications skills; verbally, written, face-to-face and over the phone with customers and co-workers
  • Impressive proposal writing skills and presentation skills
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education; preferred concentration in Telecom, IT or business-related discipline
  • Travel availability daily within region to customers, and with notice to other locations worldwide

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.


Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Especialista VMO
description:
QUEM SOMOS?


Uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo, temos como pilar a sustentabilidade e o cuidado com as pessoas. Possuímos um amplo portfólio de produtos e diversas unidades em que atuamos: Investimentos, Consórcios, Capitalização, Previdência e Vida Resgatável, Saúde, Seguros e Assistência. Trabalhamos para construir o futuro e somos comprometidos com a inovação.

Estamos nos transformando para poder acompanhar nossos clientes também no mundo digital. Com presença em mais de 100 países nos cinco continentes, somamos mais de 34 mil colaboradores em todo o mundo, mais de 3,5 mil só no Brasil.

A Fundación MAPFRE, instituição sem fins lucrativos, é a nossa acionista majoritária, o que fortalece a nossa independência e estabilidade. Entre nossos compromissos está a valorização e apoio à diversidade e inclusão, construindo ambientes mais acolhedores.

A presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de PCDs e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero na constituição das equipes é a nossa prioridade.


QUEM QUEREMOS NO NOSSO TIME


Pessoas proativas e inovadoras, capazes de identificar de forma contínua novas oportunidades e soluções para transformar algo bom em algo melhor;

Que colaborem, porque a capacidade de cooperar, contribuir e compartilhar com pessoas que têm pontos de vista diferentes nos ajudará a conseguir melhores resultados;

Que gerenciem as mudanças de forma ágil e tomem decisões rápidas e eficazes;

Que tenham curiosidade para aprender, se desenvolver, crescer e sentir que estão contribuindo aos objetivos da empresa.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER COMO ESPECIALISTA VMO


  • Conduzir a construção de planos de negócio para os projetos estratégicos da companhia com a viabilidade financeira e geração de valor, apoiando a tomada de decisão para priorização e desenvolvimento;
  • Realizar acompanhamento dos projetos junto às áreas clientes durante e pós desenvolvimento, garantindo que estejam vinculados às metas e objetivos estratégicos, bem como seu atingimento com report executivo;
  • Preparar relatórios e apresentações executivas para informar o progresso e os resultados dos projetos, destacando pontos de desvio e risco da entrega.
  • Manter comunicação clara e contínua com todos os stakeholders, promovendo a transparência das atividades do VMO.
  • Organizar agendas semanais de acompanhamento dos projetos estratégicos, visando identificar, avaliar e reportar desvios de prazo e orçamentário, bem como apoiar em ações para mitigação de riscos;
  • Garantir visão integrada entre os projetos;
  • Atuação em ambiente dinâmico, levantamento de requisitos/premissas para projetos estratégicos e interação com diferentes áreas da organização




O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ


  • Ensino Superior Completo em áreas financeiras ou correlatas;
  • Sólido conhecimento financeiro e capacidade de análise de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para dialogar com a alta gestão.
  • Experiência em levantamento de premissas e acompanhamento de projetos ágeis;
  • Diferencial: experiência prévia com ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e uso de ferramentas de apoio (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint).


LOCAL DE TRABALHO: SÃO PAULO/ W Torre -SP (3 dias presenciais e 2 dias trabalho remoto)


CUIDAMOS DOS NOSSOS


A MAPFRE é feita de pessoas, por isso retribuímos da melhor maneira possível o comprometimento de nossos colaboradores, que contam com:


  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação e, uma vez por ano um VA em dobro, tudo 100% subsidiado pela empresa;
  • Seguro de Vida e Plano Médico e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes, pois proteger as pessoas não é só um discurso;
  • Incentivo à Previdência Privada, pensando na tranquilidade do seu futuro;
  • Programa de participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Anual);
  • Wellhub
  • Clube de Benefícios MAPFRE, que proporciona descontos;
  • Extensão da licença e maternidade para 180 dias e paternidade para 20 dias. E os papais e mamães com filhos de até 6 anos também recebem o Auxílio Creche ou Auxílio Babá;
  • Praticamos horário flexível com algumas possibilidades de entrada e nossos escritórios são próximos às estações da CPTM. Mas se você preferir vir de bike, temos também o bicicletário;
  • Disponibilização de cursos e treinamentos presenciais e E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, Universidade Corporativa MAPFRE. Lembrando que a MAPFRE é uma empresa global, o crescimento vai além das barreiras territoriais!
  • A Assessoria do Programa Viva Leve está sempre aberta para ouvir via atendimento 0800 com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, orientações de nutricionistas, fisioterapeutas, além de consultoria Pet e orientações com profissionais da área jurídica;

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.


This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.


Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.


Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus


Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Analista Sênior de Omnicanalidade - Foco em Integração de Canais & Experiência do Cliente
description:

• Apoiar treinamentos e padronizações operacionais nas frentes omnichannel.


Esperamos que você tenha:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Estatística, Tecnologia da Informação, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência prévia em operações omnichannel no varejo ou e-commerce;

• Domínio avançado de Power BI, SQL e BigQuery para análises e tomada de decisão;

• Vivência com ferramentas como OMS, ERP, CRM e plataformas de e-commerce (Linx, VTEX, Salesforce, TOTVS, etc.);

• Capacidade de gerar insights acionáveis a partir de grandes volumes de dados, com foco em performance e cliente.


Vai ser um golaço se você também tiver:

• Conhecimento em metodologias de CX, UX e Design Thinking;

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de tracking e análise de jornada digital (Google Analytics, tagueamento, etc.);

• Participação em projetos de transformação digital e integração de canais.


Competências que fazem a diferença:

• Raciocínio analítico e visão sistêmica;

• Proatividade, senso de dono e orientação para resultado;

• Boa articulação com diferentes áreas e influência sem autoridade;

• Organização e disciplina para garantir a excelência nos processos.


O que você encontra por aqui:

• Um time que acredita na potência da integração entre canais para transformar a experiência de compra;

• Liberdade para propor, testar e construir com autonomia;

• Um ambiente dinâmico, com muita troca, desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento.


Se você curte trabalhar com dados, integração de canais e experiência do cliente, vem jogar com a gente!

title: Data Scientist
description:
DYWIDAG stands as a global leader in construction and infrastructure technology that works with government authorities, asset owners, construction companies, and design offices to support their infrastructure projects. We have expanded into over 50 countries worldwide and continue to keep infrastructure safe and secure every single day.


Purpose of the Job

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
  • Rapidly prototype and deliver MVPs to address business needs, especially in pricing and sales forecasting.
  • Collaborate with the Global BI Team and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
  • Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
  • Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
  • Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).

title: Arquiteto de IA
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Responsabilidades:

✔ Projetar, explicar e evoluir sistemas mono/multiagente (planning, tool use/function calling, memória, orquestração por eventos), definindo padrões para cooperação entre agentes e integração com serviços do banco (APIs internas, filas, streams, sistemas legados);

✔ Atuar em model engineering (seleção de modelos, prompt design avançado, ajustes finos – LoRA/PEFT, caching e compressão de prompts);

✔ Desenhar pipelines de RAG em nível empresarial (ingestão, chunking, re-ranking, busca híbrida, políticas de confidencialidade por índice);

✔ Implementar tracing, telemetry, feedback loops, guardrails, e experimentação controlada em produção (LLMOps e observabilidade);

✔ Garantir segurança, compliance e privacidade dos dados (privacy-by-design, mascaramento de PII, auditoria, LGPD);

✔ Otimizar latência e custo (batching, streaming, fallbacks, caching e thresholds de confiança);

✔ Mentorar engenheiros e multiplicar impacto por meio de revisões técnicas, boas práticas e guias de referência;

✔ Colaborar com áreas de Produto e Negócio, transformando aprendizados de POCs em metodologias e práticas consolidadas.


Requisitos:

✔ 7–10+ anos de experiência em arquitetura de software e mínimo de 3 anos entregando produtos com LLMs em produção;

✔ Domínio de LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama ou equivalentes) e técnicas de ajuste fino (PEFT/LoRA);

✔ Conhecimento sólido em arquiteturas agentic (ReAct, Plan-Act, tool use, memória, retrieval orquestrado);

✔ Experiência em RAG avançado e uso de vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, pgvector);

✔ Vivência com clouds de IA (Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) e práticas de CI/CD, conteinerização e IaC;

✔ Proficiência em Python e/ou TypeScript, integração com frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Functions/Agents);

✔ Experiência com tracing (Langfuse/OpenTelemetry), avaliação de modelos e experimentação A/B;

✔ Conhecimento em segurança e privacidade de dados no setor financeiro (LGPD, auditoria, segregação de dados);

✔ Comunicação técnica clara e liderança de arquitetura;

✔ Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais:

➕ Experiência prévia em big techs e/ou startups de IA;

➕ Vivência em ambientes data/AI-first e de entrega em escala;

➕ Conhecimento em Model Risk Management (model cards, change management, bias & harm checks);

➕ Experiência em avaliação automática/assistida (rubricas, métricas de segurança), red teaming e content filters;

➕ Contribuições OSS, publicações ou palestras em IA;

➕ Espanhol fluente.
